bulk-git.description: Runs git operations across a set of repos in parallel.

git-at.description: Runs a single git command against one repo from a bulk-git config.

sync-all.description: Syncs all repos in a config: aborts if any are dirty, then clones missing repos and pulls+pushes the rest.

list.description: Lists every toolbelt command and its purpose.

doctor.description: Health check: env vars, git pull, and test results.
